Name: Single Column
Intent: Keep one reading or task path clear
Keywords: single column linear article form docs focused mobile
Responsive Notes: Naturally reflows; cap text width and preserve spacing at zoom
Accessibility Notes: Strong source order; use headings, landmarks, and skip links
Implementation Notes: Use normal flow with a readable max width
Anti-Patterns: Wall of text without headings|overly narrow content

Name: F Pattern
Intent: Support efficient scanning of text-heavy content
Keywords: f pattern scan text documentation search results headings
Responsive Notes: Stack to a priority order on mobile; front-load useful words
Accessibility Notes: Do not rely on left position alone; use headings and descriptive links
Implementation Notes: Format content with headings, lists, bold signal, and concise paragraphs
Anti-Patterns: Unformatted wall of text|important content only on right

Name: Z Pattern
Intent: Guide a low-density page from message to action
Keywords: z pattern landing page diagonal scan hero cta
Responsive Notes: Collapse to explicit top-to-bottom priority on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Make the action a real control and do not encode meaning in position
Implementation Notes: Use a clear grid or flex layout and strong heading hierarchy
Anti-Patterns: Decorative diagonal path without readable order|multiple primary actions

Name: 12 Column Grid
Intent: Create repeatable alignment and responsive composition
Keywords: 12 column grid css grid system gutters layout
Responsive Notes: Reflow tracks with minmax and container queries; avoid fixed widths
Accessibility Notes: Keep DOM order aligned with visual order and maintain focus sequence
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid tracks and named areas where useful
Anti-Patterns: Line placement that reorders content|fixed container overflow

Name: Asymmetric Grid
Intent: Use unequal spatial weight to establish hierarchy
Keywords: asymmetric grid editorial portfolio varied spans visual weight
Responsive Notes: Simplify to one or two columns on narrow widths and remove fragile overlap
Accessibility Notes: Keep source order and focus order predictable; protect text contrast
Implementation Notes: Use explicit spans and test long content
Anti-Patterns: Asymmetry without reading priority|clipped focus|empty decorative cells

Name: Broken Grid
Intent: Subvert alignment for a deliberate brand or editorial moment
Keywords: broken grid overlap post grid art directed misalignment
Responsive Notes: Reset overlap and negative margins on small screens
Accessibility Notes: Do not use visual overlap to hide required content or alter logical order
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid and z-index with an explicit mobile fallback
Anti-Patterns: Broken grid as default product shell|overflow|focus hidden behind layer

Name: Bento Grid
Intent: Package varied related content in modular cells
Keywords: bento grid modular tiles feature cards product overview apple
Responsive Notes: Stack tiles or use container queries; preserve hero before supports
Accessibility Notes: Keep DOM reading order and keyboard order meaningful
Implementation Notes: Use grid template areas, aspect ratio, and reserved media space
Anti-Patterns: Identical rounded cards|bento for dense tables|visual order mismatch

Name: Faceted Discovery
Intent: Let people narrow a large set by independent meaningful attributes
Keywords: faceted discovery search filters taxonomy browse category price location metadata
Responsive Notes: Use a filter disclosure and applied-filter summary on mobile; keep query and result count visible
Accessibility Notes: Label each facet, announce result changes, offer clear-all, and do not use color-only selected state
Implementation Notes: Use URL state when shareable and stable result identity
Anti-Patterns: irrelevant facets|filter state hidden|no-results dead end

Name: Masonry
Intent: Show variable-height visual items as a dense collection
Keywords: masonry waterfall pinterest gallery variable height images
Responsive Notes: Use native grid lanes when supported or a fallback that keeps order clear
Accessibility Notes: Ensure DOM and focus sequence remain understandable; provide pagination or load more
Implementation Notes: Use CSS grid lanes with a documented fallback or ordered columns
Anti-Patterns: Masonry for pricing or comparison|infinite load without control|visual order mismatch

Name: Card Collection
Intent: Group self-contained browsing choices
Keywords: cards card grid product media directory team dashboard
Responsive Notes: Use responsive minmax and one clear action per card
Accessibility Notes: Give each card a heading, named action, and result context
Implementation Notes: Use list or region semantics and stable media aspect ratio
Anti-Patterns: Card wrapper around every row|multiple competing actions|hover-only detail

Name: Lists
Intent: Optimize scanning, sorting, and repeated actions
Keywords: list activity inbox notifications search results files
Responsive Notes: Naturally stack and support compact or comfortable density
Accessibility Notes: Use `ul` and `li` where appropriate and label row actions
Implementation Notes: Use row templates with predictable metadata alignment
Anti-Patterns: Cards for uniform rows|unlabeled row chevrons|tiny target

Name: Tables
Intent: Compare exact values and relationships
Keywords: table data grid comparison pricing transactions records
Responsive Notes: Allow horizontal overflow only for data that truly needs it; offer responsive row alternative
Accessibility Notes: Use captions, headers, scopes, and a non-color distinction for status
Implementation Notes: Use native table markup and contain wide content
Anti-Patterns: Table used for layout|unlabeled columns|color-only cells

Name: Timeline
Intent: Explain change or sequence through time
Keywords: timeline history roadmap activity order milestones
Responsive Notes: Collapse alternating or horizontal layouts to one vertical rail
Accessibility Notes: Use ordered list semantics and time elements; preserve sequence
Implementation Notes: Use a list with a decorative marker layer
Anti-Patterns: Alternating visual order differs from DOM|marker-only dates

Name: Dashboard Grid
Intent: Support glanceable metrics and drill-down actions
Keywords: dashboard grid kpi charts admin analytics overview
Responsive Notes: Use nested grids with `minmax(0, 1fr)` and priority stack on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Use landmarks, text chart alternatives, and one scroll owner
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid areas and reserve chart space
Anti-Patterns: Chart wall|nested scroll traps|3D decoration for routine data

Name: Split Screen
Intent: Give copy and media equal opening weight
Keywords: split screen split hero copy image code product
Responsive Notes: Stack copy before media on mobile and preserve source order
Accessibility Notes: Keep the main heading and action first in DOM and visual reading order
Implementation Notes: Use grid columns and `min-height: 100dvh` only when appropriate
Anti-Patterns: 50/50 split that hides copy|visual reorder breaking focus

Name: Full Bleed Hero
Intent: Make an image, video, or atmosphere establish a page
Keywords: full bleed hero edge to edge campaign video background
Responsive Notes: Use responsive image, `dvh`, scrim, and shorter mobile crop
Accessibility Notes: Decorative media gets empty alt; text gets contrast and labels
Implementation Notes: Use CSS grid layering and poster-first media
Anti-Patterns: Text over raw image|autoplay blocking content|hero as only explanation

Name: Editorial Spread
Intent: Translate print rhythm into a web reading sequence
Keywords: editorial spread magazine pull quote folio drop cap photo essay
Responsive Notes: Remove overlap and use one column or ordered two column layout on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Preserve article semantics, captions, quote semantics, and contrast
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid with explicit overlap only for nonessential decoration
Anti-Patterns: Print styling applied to thin content|line length too wide|caption detached

Name: Holy Grail
Intent: Keep stable header, navigation, main, aside, and footer regions
Keywords: holy grail layout header nav main aside footer documentation shell
Responsive Notes: Collapse side regions into disclosure or drawer without changing source order
Accessibility Notes: Use landmarks, skip link, focus return, and one scroll owner
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid template areas and `minmax(0, 1fr)`
Anti-Patterns: Nested scrollbars|focus trapped drawer|fixed widths

Name: Sticky Rail
Intent: Keep filters, table of contents, or next action in view
Keywords: sticky rail sticky sidebar toc filters reading progress
Responsive Notes: Disable or move rail below content when viewport is narrow; account for sticky header
Accessibility Notes: Use labelled navigation, anchor scroll margin, and focus visibility
Implementation Notes: Use `position: sticky` with a bounded internal scroll only when necessary
Anti-Patterns: Sticky rail covering headings|ancestor overflow breaking stickiness|secondary rail required for task

Name: Parallax Layers
Intent: Create a sense of place from layers that move at different rates
Keywords: parallax layers depth scroll background foreground
Responsive Notes: Disable on mobile or reduced motion and preserve a static composition
Accessibility Notes: Provide a stable non-parallax path and do not tie required content to scroll precision
Implementation Notes: Use transform layers and normal document scrolling
Anti-Patterns: Scroll hijack|parallax on every section|motion as discovery gate

Name: Scrollytelling Chapter
Intent: Change a figure or scene as text chapters advance
Keywords: scrollytelling sticky figure chapters data journalism explainer
Responsive Notes: Stack each figure and text beat on mobile instead of pinning one global scene
Accessibility Notes: Provide a sequential unpinned alternative and preserve text and keyboard order
Implementation Notes: Use IntersectionObserver or scroll timelines with a static fallback
Anti-Patterns: Camera ride with no chapter meaning|scroll-only essential content|unpausable motion

Name: Carousel
Intent: Show a small related set in one prime space
Keywords: carousel slider slideshow product gallery featured content
Responsive Notes: Use visible controls, touch swipe as optional, and avoid forcing all content into one frame
Accessibility Notes: Provide pause, keyboard navigation, live update state, focus control, and no hidden focused slide
Implementation Notes: Use a labelled region with buttons and explicit current item
Anti-Patterns: Autoplay without pause|essential content only after several taps|focus moves unexpectedly

Name: Mega Menu
Intent: Expose broad information architecture through grouped links
Keywords: mega menu navigation categories ecommerce government enterprise
Responsive Notes: Use disclosure or drawer on mobile and keep link groups readable
Accessibility Notes: Use button disclosure semantics, Escape close, focus return, and plain links
Implementation Notes: Use CSS Grid and focus-within without hover dependency
Anti-Patterns: Role menu for ordinary site navigation|hover-only open|deep ungrouped links

Name: Tabs
Intent: Switch between related views without leaving context
Keywords: tabs tablist panel settings product detail dashboard
Responsive Notes: Stack tabs or make them horizontally scrollable with visible selected state on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Use correct tab semantics or native links when URLs matter; keep keyboard model clear
Implementation Notes: Use APG tab pattern only when panels are true view alternatives
Anti-Patterns: Tabs for unrelated destinations|hidden active state|deep content with no URL

Name: Step Indicator
Intent: Show position and progress through a bounded task
Keywords: step indicator wizard checkout form eligibility onboarding
Responsive Notes: Use short labels or current step only on mobile; do not make progress the only navigation
Accessibility Notes: Expose current step text, allow predictable back, and move focus to new heading
Implementation Notes: Use ordered steps with progress text and direct links only where safe
Anti-Patterns: Decorative dots without labels|step completion by color only|back path lost

Name: Command Palette
Intent: Give keyboard-heavy apps a fast action and search surface
Keywords: command palette command menu quick actions keyboard shortcut search
Responsive Notes: Use a full-screen or bottom sheet mobile alternative with visible trigger
Accessibility Notes: Use dialog or listbox semantics correctly, announce results, and expose clickable actions
Implementation Notes: Keep command registry separate from visual menu and provide normal buttons
Anti-Patterns: Shortcut-only actions|unlabelled search|focus lost on close

Name: Infinite Feed
Intent: Support repeated browsing of a changing stream
Keywords: infinite feed social news recommendations scroll loading
Responsive Notes: Use pagination or load more and preserve URL or position where appropriate
Accessibility Notes: Announce loaded content, provide stop or load control, and do not steal focus
Implementation Notes: Use cursor pagination and explicit loading state
Anti-Patterns: Unbounded scroll|new items inserted above reading position|auto-play media

Name: Map List Split
Intent: Pair spatial context with a searchable list
Keywords: map list split directory real estate travel location
Responsive Notes: List is the mobile primary path; map becomes optional or follows the selected result
Accessibility Notes: Provide list, address, and route alternatives; map markers need names and status
Implementation Notes: Keep selection state in DOM and synchronize map as enhancement
Anti-Patterns: Map-only results|marker color-only status|map traps scroll

Name: Kanban Board
Intent: Move work items through stages and inspect status
Keywords: kanban board columns drag drop project management workflow
Responsive Notes: Turn columns into horizontal or per-column lists on mobile with explicit move actions
Accessibility Notes: Dragging needs single-pointer, keyboard, and menu alternatives; status cannot be color only
Implementation Notes: Use buttons or menus for move and drag as enhancement
Anti-Patterns: Drag-only card movement|horizontal scroll required|hidden column state

Name: Calendar And Agenda
Intent: Schedule, inspect, and change time-based items
Keywords: calendar agenda scheduling availability timezone event
Responsive Notes: Offer agenda or list view and show timezone; avoid dense month grid as only view
Accessibility Notes: Use labelled date controls, keyboard navigation, text event list, and no drag-only reschedule
Implementation Notes: Use native date inputs when appropriate and separate data from grid presentation
Anti-Patterns: drag-only reschedule|ambiguous timezone|month grid unreadable on mobile

Name: Infinite Canvas
Intent: Manipulate an open spatial work area
Keywords: infinite canvas whiteboard design layers zoom pan spatial objects
Responsive Notes: Provide focused object or list mode on mobile and keep zoom controls visible
Accessibility Notes: Every object needs name, selection state, keyboard or menu path, and text summary
Implementation Notes: Use canvas renderer with semantic overlay and model ownership
Anti-Patterns: canvas-only document|gesture-only zoom|no reset or fit action

Name: Spatial Stage
Intent: Place a subject in a depth-aware stage around content
Keywords: spatial stage 3d scene camera depth immersive webxr model
Responsive Notes: Use inline 2D or static stage first and treat immersive mode as optional
Accessibility Notes: Provide DOM content, keyboard controls, static poster, reduced motion, and no-WebGL path
Implementation Notes: Use feature detection, bounded camera, quality tiers, and resource ownership
Anti-Patterns: 3D as only navigation|headset required|unbounded camera|blank fallback

Name: 3D Product Viewer
Intent: Let a person inspect a physical object from useful views
Keywords: 3d viewer product rotate inspect model glb material camera configurator
Responsive Notes: Keep title, price, action, and preset controls outside the canvas; shorten scene on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Provide static gallery, buttons for views and zoom, keyboard path, text details, and reduced motion
Implementation Notes: Use Three.js or React Three Fiber with GLB, poster, quality tiers, and disposal
Anti-Patterns: auto-rotate only|drag-only inspection|canvas-only product facts|full DPR everywhere

Name: Comparison Table
Intent: Compare plans, products, or exact feature values
Keywords: comparison table pricing plans products feature matrix
Responsive Notes: On mobile use stacked plan sections or row labels and do not force a huge table
Accessibility Notes: Use table headers, scope, labels, and a non-table alternative when reflow fails
Implementation Notes: Use native table for relationships and CSS only for cosmetic layout
Anti-Patterns: unlabeled checkmarks|color-only differences|wide table blocking purchase

Name: Tree Navigation
Intent: Expose nested content with predictable expansion
Keywords: tree navigation taxonomy docs category file browser hierarchy
Responsive Notes: Collapse depth and provide breadcrumbs or search on mobile
Accessibility Notes: Use disclosure or tree semantics only when the keyboard model is implemented; otherwise use links
Implementation Notes: Prefer disclosure lists for site navigation and reserve tree role for actual tree interaction
Anti-Patterns: deep collapsed maze|hover expansion|focus disappears on branch open
